experiments.title: Guarded decimation of the physical convergence monitor
experiments.evidence: The norm-only pass traverses canonical bond rows every iteration, independently of PCG gamma/direction energy. N01 failed when an exact zero residual occurred between scheduled checks; cheap exact-zero detection can trigger the unchanged monitor before that breakdown.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Check the full bond-gradient norm every four iterations plus initial/final-cap checks. On intervening iterations, detect an all-zero stored residual with a block integer vote and immediately run the original norm and true-residual verification. Never accept from the cheap vote itself; any other breakdown still rejects.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: 2–6 ms heavy mean if removing three of four sparse monitor traversals offsets the cheap vote and up to three additional iterations; hypothesis only
experiments.confidence: medium correctness until scaled/cap/zero-load tests pass; medium application benefit
experiments.experiment_cost: One monitored-loop change reusing N01 patch with a concrete early-zero repair; unchanged analytic/3D/mode/cap oracles, memory/sync checks, wall and matched timing
experiments.supporting_measurements: Previously failing exact-zero case and full numerical suite pass; fewer norm-only traversals, unchanged final gates, lower complete-step means without idle/peak regression
experiments.refuting_measurements: Any unhandled early breakdown/cap failure, increased iterations erase savings, or no matched application gain
experiments.baseline: retained E12 until a new candidate qualifies
experiments.prior_evidence: N01.md; initial fixed-interval scheme failed exact convergence; do not retry it unchanged
experiments.conclusion: Retain: heavy complete-step mean6.92–7.59% lower, idle no meaningful regression, heavy peaks lower in matched cohort; deadline misses unchanged; existing migration/native-memory gaps not waived.

experiments.title: Cache operator neighbor metadata and mass-scaled vectors
experiments.evidence: Reused E12 late SASS counters show two large long-scoreboard sites at endpoint-index→inertia/vector address chains (68394/65560 samples). The node operator repeatedly reloads fixed neighbor metadata and recomputes D*v at every adjacent row. These are stall samples, not additive application time.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Build a current GPU CSR neighbor cache per active component, with explicit static endpoints. Fuse the identical FP32 D*v into existing residual/direction producers and reuse component-owned nsW scratch; remove dependent neighbor-inertia loads and repeated scaling. Preserve canonical norm ownership, operator accumulation order, original equations and cooperative path.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: 2–6 ms heavy mean if shorter gather dependencies offset cache preparation and extra vector stores; N12 may reduce the remaining norm opportunity
experiments.confidence: high algebraic equivalence; medium performance confidence
experiments.experiment_cost: Four private CUDA fragments and one2*bonds index allocation; existing interleaved/topology/cap/numerical tests, memory/init/sync gates, wall and full matched timing
experiments.supporting_measurements: Unchanged independent force/equilibrium results and physical histories; fewer dependent global loads and lower complete-step time including setup
experiments.refuting_measurements: Cache lifecycle/static endpoint errors, new stores/setup/register pressure erase savings, or no full-suite gain
experiments.conclusion: Retain small0.62–0.82% full-step heavy mean improvement, idle no meaningful regression; startup-plus-heavy total lower, no peak/deadline/startup-only gain. Matching recorded poses and physical histories; old migration/memory gaps remain.
experiments.architectural_benefit: The private pre-scaled operator interface and explicit fixed-neighbor representation enable N16 component-local storage without duplicating the physical operator. This is additional to its measured small gain.

experiments.title: Amortize destruction lifetime bookkeeping allocation
experiments.evidence: N12 normal four-worker CPU perf at step82:9/116 CPU samples (7.76%) in PxArray<uint64_t>::recreate under IslandSim::addNode -> bindNativeNodeHandle -> fragment reserve. PxArray resize reserves exact requested capacity; mPreSolveLifetimes currently grows one slot per newly registered node. Step103 also samples this allocation path. Samples are CPU activity, not independent wall milliseconds.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Reserve the custom GPU pre-solve lifetime array to the existing node storage capacity before increasing its active size. Preserve initialization, generation increments, lifetime values, CPU/GPU order and actual fragment creation. Capacity-only change; no new physics objects or delayed data.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Potential5–15 ms first-fracture peak and0.1–0.8 ms heavy mean;0–0.1 ms idle/setup; requires matched timing including initialization
experiments.confidence: high semantic equivalence; medium application benefit given direct call-stack evidence
experiments.experiment_cost: One custom CPU bookkeeping growth change, rebuild native consumers, lifetime/correction/checkpoint/sleep/query tests and native memory gate, full A/B suite
experiments.supporting_measurements: Fewer lifetime array reallocations/copies, identical generation and physical histories, lower registration/full-step peaks after charging setup
experiments.refuting_measurements: Growth is not material on repeated controls, changed lifetime semantics, native memory qualification failure, or full-suite regression
experiments.conclusion: Not qualified; preserve capacity-growth design for later requalification. Sixteen native behavior tests pass, candidate correction memcheck reports1566 findings; fresh N10 control reports1561 with different first reported failure. No timing, no attribution or tool exemption. Reverted only experiment CPU source.

experiments.title: Guarded mixed-precision block-Jacobi application
experiments.evidence: N12 late selected stress spends41.84% elapsed cycles on FP64; historical work census is overwhelmingly anchored, while the current one-block preconditioner still applies the ten-coefficient rigid inverse in FP64. N07 exact-zero specialization and N08 reciprocal caching did not help. Prior rejected FP32 work also approximated polynomial off-diagonal passes; this candidate approximates only the current single block application.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Keep exact inverse construction/reference path. At setup, cache eligible FP32 rigid coefficients with a conservative represented-SPD/range certificate. Apply eligible fixed coefficients in FP32 for bounded RHS values; outside that arithmetic range apply the SAME rounded coefficients in FP64. Ineligible matrices retain original fixed FP64 coefficients. Keep projection, accumulated solution, recovery and authoritative residual unchanged. Add a separate independent2e-5 intermediate response/symmetry envelope test; preserve all existing exact and final physical tests.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: 2–10 ms heavy mean if FP64 block application is exposed and guards/cache/extra iterations do not erase savings; hypothesis only
experiments.confidence: medium numerical feasibility with conservative fixed-matrix guards; low-to-medium performance until full-step tests
experiments.experiment_cost: Private coefficient cache/application plus independent dense long-double basis/mixed-load oracle over scaling/eligibility cases; six source/test fragments; full numerical/sanitizer/wall/timing/profile qualification
experiments.supporting_measurements: New explicit intermediate envelope and unchanged final physical gates pass; less FP64 work and lower full-step mean/peak including setup
experiments.refuting_measurements: Intermediate error/SPD/scaling or final quality failure; guard/register/setup overhead or extra iterations erase full-step gains
experiments.conclusion: Retain:1.71–2.10% lower heavy full-step mean and lower setup-plus-heavy total; idle short-screen regression does not repeat. Peak distributions overlap with slightly higher candidate worst values; no peak/deadline/startup-only claim. Numerical/sanitizer/wall/trajectory gates pass relative to retained baseline; historical migration/native-memory gaps remain.

experiments.title: Current-input subspace warm start
experiments.evidence: Existing stored bond warm start does not exploit a small history of solved load-response directions.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Retain one converged node correction per matching operator generation. Recompute its response and best scalar against the CURRENT projected residual, charge a used initial-guess step against the iteration cap, reconstruct the original residual, then restart ordinary PCG. Never certify stored-output reuse from the new guess. Invalidate on topology/cold/failure; save only converged responses.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: 2–12 ms sustained steps if load subspaces recur
experiments.confidence: low to medium
experiments.experiment_cost: Five private source/test fragments including independent correlated/sign-reversed/zero current-load chain oracle; existing cold/split/cap/reuse tests and memory/init/sync checks; full idle/heavy A/B, iteration census and profiles.
experiments.supporting_measurements: Fewer true iterations after charging history setup, no stale accepted solution
experiments.refuting_measurements: History cost or changing impacts makes projection ineffective

attempts.conclusion: Initial ordering prevents exact settled reuse; fixed by trying history only after failed initial authoritative monitor.

experiments.title: Separate anchored and free component execution
experiments.evidence: Source audit: isolated no-live-bond chunks are already omitted by labelDeviceStressBonds/rootFlags and labelDeviceStressNodes, so the original empty-system hypothesis has no reachable target. Current common component kernel retains free-projection code/resources even for the overwhelmingly anchored iterative work. N10 uses108 registers,32.09% occupancy in the later selected capture.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Use separate GPU-owned anchored/free work queues and template the component recurrence/preparation/preconditioning so the anchored specialization omits certified zero-dimensional nullspace work and its compiler resource footprint. Current validated mode dimension selects ownership; free components retain all projection. Preserve current equations and per-component numerical order; no CPU count readback.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Potential1–5 ms heavy mean if reduced anchored register/shared footprint improves residency; charge queue preparation and extra launch. No established saving.
experiments.confidence: high semantic equivalence under current mode certificate; medium compiler/resource benefit
experiments.experiment_cost: Private GPU component queues and templated recurrence/preconditioner, kernel launch updates; original free/anchored/interleaved/cap/topology tests, sanitizers, full A/B and counters
experiments.supporting_measurements: Both queue ownership and original physical gates pass, anchored resources fall, complete-step heavy mean/peaks improve without idle regression; independent queues enable later size decomposition
experiments.refuting_measurements: Queue divergence or invalid certificate, resource footprint unchanged, extra launch/cache costs erase benefit, full-suite regression
experiments.reassessment: Original no-live-interface singleton target removed before experiment: native topology already omits those rows. This audit does not count as a completed experiment.

experiments.title: Keep the recurrence local to component execution

Pack current per-row neighbor indices to local ranks, validate membership, and fuse shared writes into existing producers/barriers. Larger components retain global storage. Add512/516-node interleaved analytic boundary cases; measure resource cost and whole-step benefit.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Potential0.5–3 ms heavy mean from shorter repeated vector gathers; confidence reduced by earlier shared-cache regressions. No expected idle benefit; charge setup and occupancy.
experiments.confidence: high algebraic equivalence with mapping tests; low-to-medium performance
experiments.experiment_cost: coherent component workspace redesign; sanitizer and stress tests
experiments.supporting_measurements: Less redundant traffic/barriers without register/shared-memory occupancy losses
experiments.refuting_measurements: Spills/residency losses exceed saved work

This isolates execution granularity from preconditioner strength. experiments.title: Cache projection-factor diagonal reciprocals
experiments.evidence: projectMotionComponent serially divides by the same six Cholesky diagonals twice per projection, across two projections per iteration. Factors change only with validated topology setup. This serial dependency remains after node reciprocal caching. Historical component census and N08 no-gain screen substantially lower this target priority; census is not current timing.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: After unchanged FP64 Cholesky construction, store reciprocal diagonals in the existing packed factor diagonal slots and multiply during forward/back substitution. Keep off-diagonal factors, projection basis and final physical tolerances. No new device allocation or per-iteration validation loop.

experiments.title: Skip exactly zero rigid-block coupling arithmetic
experiments.evidence: Current E12 applies the full coupled rigid inverse for every node. Axis-aligned symmetric neighborhoods can have exactly zero skew coupling and off-diagonal rotational inverse. Historical native component census places>99.9% of node iteration work in retained anchored structures; N08 projection caching did not reduce application mean.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Recognize only exact numerical zeros in all three skew and all three off-diagonal coefficients, then apply the exact six diagonal products. Keep the existing coupled FP64 path for every nonzero coefficient. No precision reduction, tolerance or load change.
affected_scenarios: retained anchored structures during later destruction

Current SM120/CUDA13.4 code uses one block-Jacobi inverse, a different register footprint, and the fixed one-wave256-shot suite. This is an explicitly labeled re-test, not a novel algorithm or prior accepted win; current matched application measurements alone can qualify it.

policy: Adaptive ranking; source audits/preparation do not count as completed experiments; one GPU candidate at a time. Reassess after three unsuccessful coherent-family experiments.
next_diagnosis: Use N12 profiles for N10 gather work. CPU perf capture available for lifecycle diagnosis; native sequence-dependent memory findings remain unresolved.
acceptance_policy: Retain verified application speedups, and correctness-qualified performance-neutral enabling changes with a concrete architectural benefit/follow-up and no material scenario regression. Label the two separately; user clarification2026-09-11. Quality failures are not neutral results.
final_validation_plan: After20 completed hypotheses, compare the final retained composition against frozen starting E12 in a fresh matched3x600 idle/heavy A-before/B/A-after campaign. Report batch gain from that cohort; do not add successive percentages. Include initialization, maxima, exact budgets and fixed windows, and retain existing physical qualification gaps.
next_work: Prioritize first-class accepted-world export/restore, reuse PhysX collection serialization where valid, extend destruction state, qualify untouched/restored next-tick and continuation parity. Then single-tick A/A and A/B over the24-case semantic suite; larger structure/island catalog follows. Prefix baseline10 is complete and is not snapshot qualification.
